identity: ONE original young armoured warden, the Basalt Warden, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the youthful face, the shoulder-length dark brown hair, the grey scarf and layered grey tabard, the black iron plate armour, the brown leather straps and pouches, and the armoured boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE short mace with an angular dark metal head; the screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE tall black cracked basalt pavise shield with an angular split top and copper bands. Preserve the mace, the basalt shield and the proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, mace, the whole shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, dust, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the shield stays a rigid stone slab and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady, watchful idle that loops. The warden breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the mace turns a little in the low hand, the shield settles on the arm, the head turns slightly to scan and the scarf stirs, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE mace blow toward screen right. The warden raises the mace high beside the head as the knees bend, then steps into a lunge and swings it over the top of the shield to full reach at screen right, the shield held close, draws back and settles into the original stance. One blow only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: The warden starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The head and shoulders twist back behind the shield and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the mace and the shield, then the warden straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low behind the basalt shield, setting it forward in front of the body with the shoulder braced against it and the mace drawn back, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. The warden raises the mace high overhead as a signal, the shield held steady, holds the pose briefly, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. The warden sinks onto both knees leaning on the shield, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward onto the fallen shield and lies flat, finishing motionless with the head at screen right, the shield flat beneath the body and the mace on the ground beside it. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
